correctness.rationale: For every odd field of characteristic >=7, the proof accounts for zero-sum pairs, diagonal v=w, all off-diagonal conic parameters and excluded values; elliptic character-sum identities are verified algebraically. Complete independent two-sum enumerations in 23 prime fields and 4 quadratic extensions agree with the exact formula; these tests support but do not replace the all-q proof.

value.rationale: Exact unweighted fourth moments are natural arithmetic measures of cancellation for generalized Kloosterman phases. This formula completely determines the inverse-cube graph energy in every extension field from three prime-field elliptic traces, while exhibiting a nontrivial reciprocal-involution splitting of an apparent genus-two character sum. It provides an explicit q-dependent arithmetic correction beyond the classical rational inverse-graph case and an effective all-extension recurrence.
